text: りかけいのおとこの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！

structure.jp: りかけいのおとこの　＊が

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action comes toward you. しかけてきた = 'came at you and started (a battle)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (same person)
patterns.explanation: The の right before the name says the label and the name are the same person: the label tells what kind of person the name is. りかけいのおとこの　＊ = '＊ the science-type man'.
